# weft_keypair (Resource)

Declares an SSH keypair — mirrors the mock HCL `keypair` block. Exposes the resolved file_path and public_key for reference by weft_instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# weft_keypair is local-only — no gRPC call is made. It reads the public
# key from <file_path>.pub at apply time and exposes it as a computed
# attribute so weft_instance can reference it without hard-coding paths.
resource "weft_keypair" "main" {
  name      = "main"
  file_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
}

resource "weft_instance" "debian" {
  name = "web-01"
  disk {
    from = "oci://ghcr.io/example/debian:13"
    size = "20Gi"
  }
  ssh {
    user         = "debian"
    keypair_path = weft_keypair.main.file_path
  }
}

output "public_key" {
  value = weft_keypair.main.public_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) Path to the SSH private key file — matches mock HCL keypair.file_path. Tilde (~) is expanded.
- `name` (String) Keypair identifier — matches the mock HCL keypair block label (e.g. "mock").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Keypair identifier (mirrors `name`).
- `public_key` (String) Content of <file_path>.pub — ready to inject into authorized_keys or cloud-init.
- `resolved_path` (String) Absolute path to the private key after tilde expansion.
